question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: Such contemplation enables shaking the triple world
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: object of dhūmra-varṇaṃ contemplation is implicit; taken as a smoke-colored visualization
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
